# Provider, welcome and workspace preferences

The immutable reference is released v1.6.0 at `5202477edfe4b5d8bacfa5b2e9fd6eadd9624f7f`. The external collector imports the unchanged provider, onboarding, appearance, local-model, language and workspace controls and verifies every imported application module byte-for-byte against that commit. Actual native Codex/keyring process peers and private compatible HTTP endpoints provide external responses; neither reference factories nor production owners are patched. Maintained checks use [frozen observations](released-provider-pages.json), SHA-256 `56ecf65cc543ccd3bf574365efe455c3dea3d9afbf95891a2c5da184d5792638`, without an interpreter.

The explicit isolated check matches 47 released transactions and 290 GTK states: eighteen provider-section/catalog transactions, nine provider-save transactions, eleven welcome flows, six workspace forms and three download-ownership transactions. A separate ordinary native check matches 243 language labels/readiness decisions, declared language sets and persisted ISO aliases for the three retained models.

Provider forms retain each route's model draft, trimmed manual aliases, saved/unlisted and hidden models, independent thinking/Fast choices, chunk duration, collapsed connection details and controlled readiness/status messages. Refresh uses the edited speech/rewrite route through the real five-second discovery factory, including the actual `/v1/models` paths and advertised capability filtering. Provider changes, endpoint edits, unmap and reopening invalidate gated results without selecting a catalog default or publishing an old response. Invalid model names and provider failures keep drafts and display controlled messages. Discovery owns and closes its actual child/private workspace; no turn or user content is sent.

Provider Apply preserves failed validation/save drafts, rejects incomplete local models, and stores entered synthetic credentials through the actual native keyring boundary before publishing configuration. Key entry clears immediately; the page remains disabled during storage, then either reports the controlled error or retries the save. No key enters settings, argv, GUI observations or configuration callbacks. This check uses only synthetic keyring data inside the private runner; it does not touch the desktop's real secret service or any managed credential.

The welcome page preserves speech, optional polishing and recorder steps, Back/reopening behavior, compatible-model validation, missing-key guidance, local readiness and final-save recovery. Skip disarms Live and automatic titles in the submitted settings. Recorder position/lines/opacity/paste controls and their synthetic captions are shared with Workspace. The local polishing example stays offline and respects reduced motion. The first native comparison observed the preview before its released 200 ms refresh interval, while the source observer explicitly invoked refresh. Removing that artificial source refresh and waiting for the real timer on both sides leaves the frozen output unchanged and the complete native comparison passes. This was an observation timing artifact, not a production/reference repair.

The only authorized model reduction is six slider choices to **Whisper Tiny, Parakeet v3 and Qwen3-ASR 1.7B**, with the largest Qwen default. Comparisons select those same stable identities and preserve their labels, language warnings, device choices, readiness and callbacks. Slider index/range reduction is intentional. Model construction performs no inference. Download work uses the actual pinned native asset/runtime owner away from GTK, with selected-generation progress and cancellation. Three actual exclusive-file-lock conflicts compare Start, failure, changed selection and Stop without any network transfer; stale completion cannot update a different choice. Native ONNX CPU readiness requires its native library, which still must join complete packaging/upgrade acceptance. Successful network-download progress and actual inference through these pages remain unverified; separate provisioning/inference evidence retains its existing scope.

Workspace submits one coherent document/Live/appearance draft, keeps failed saves editable and refreshes externally saved choices. Its prompt action uses the saved template rather than an unapplied choice. An additional native integration applies the real `ApplicationServices` save policy and immediately refreshes the same page, verifying persisted configuration and successful status without a retained borrow across the callback. An actual native page-exit fault during gated discovery keeps retained GTK labels unchanged for 600 ms, rejects late catalogs and verifies exact child/workspace reaping.

The runner isolates display/session/accessibility, HOME/XDG, network/PID/mount namespaces and device nodes, with no host focus/input/clipboard, microphone, account or content. GTK 4.22.4 and Pango 1.58.2 are recorded, at scale 1 with motion/cursor blinking disabled. These are widget/control observations, not complete-page pixel, animation, modal-search or all-scale acceptance. Temporary collectors and raw failure/success logs stay in ignored scratch.

```sh
cargo test --locked -p mluva-providers --test language_choices
cargo build --locked -p mluva-providers --bin codex-fixture-peer --bin credential-fixture-peer
bash dev/run-isolated-browser.sh tmp/native-provider-pages -- bash -c '
  export PATH="$OFFSCREEN_SESSION_ROOT/provider-tools:$PATH"
  export CREDENTIAL_FIXTURE_ROOT="$OFFSCREEN_SESSION_ROOT/keyring"
  exec cargo test --locked -p mluva-gtk --test provider_pages -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
'
```

Its [provider workflow comparison](application-providers-evidence.md) adds real Apply/service readiness, a recording-time guard, held inline catalogs, offline recovery, reopened choices and twelve exact complete-page images. The separate [Capture preferences owner](capture-preferences-evidence.md) covers inline Capture/privacy/device/key settings. Successful provisioning through the UI, all joined capture/Meeting/image/Command/Notes paths, platforms/scales, packaging/Python removal and whole-app performance remain required. Every complete-workflow matrix row stays Pending, the verified installed app/widget remain 1.6.0 and the full Rust goal stays active.
